batchProductSalesAnalysis.title: Batch Item Sales
batchProductSalesAnalysis.subtitle: Query sales for many items over a selected period, then view each store's daily sales detail.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.importHint: One item number per line; leading zeros are kept. Supports .csv and .xlsx.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.pendingQuery: Filters have changed. The visible results are for the previous query; query again to update them.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.noImportedItems: Paste or import at least one valid item number before querying sales.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.noQueryResult: Sales have not been queried yet
batchProductSalesAnalysis.noProducts: No matched products are available to display.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.selectBranch: Select a store to view daily sales
batchProductSalesAnalysis.noDailyData: No daily sales data is available.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.noBranchData: No store sales data is available.

errors.title: Request failed
errors.load: Unable to load data. Please retry.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Please retry.
errors.forbidden: You are not permitted to query sales for these stores.
errors.statistics: Daily statistics are refreshing. Run the query again.

chart.description: Blue is regular-price net sales, orange is discounted net sales and grey is net sales with an unknown price status. Returns are shown below zero. Focus a day with the keyboard for details.
chart.pointAria: {{date}}: net quantity {{quantity}}, sales {{amount}}, regular {{regular}}, discount {{discount}}, unknown {{unknown}}
chart.quantityDescription: Daily net quantity. Classification appears when discount statistics are ready.
chart.unavailableDescription: Daily net quantity. Only the reliable total is shown because the discount breakdown is unavailable.
chart.unavailablePointAria: {{date}}, net quantity {{quantity}}, sales {{amount}}, discount breakdown unavailable

batchProductSalesAnalysis.statisticsPending: Sales statistics for these dates are not ready. Please try again later.
batchProductSalesAnalysis.scopeHint: Paste item numbers or import Excel, up to {{count}} items
batchProductSalesAnalysis.fileError: Could not read the file. Check its format and try again.

discountStates.Queued: Sales are ready. Discount statistics are queued and will update automatically.
discountStates.Running: Sales are ready. Discounts are being calculated in the background.
discountStates.Backfilling: Sales are ready. Historical discount snapshots are being backfilled and will update automatically.
discountStates.Refreshing: Showing the last verified discount statistics while the background refresh is running.
discountStates.Partial: Some dates have verified discount results. Other dates are still unavailable and are shown as unknown.
discountStates.Unavailable: Sales are ready. Discount statistics are currently unavailable.
discountStates.Failed: Sales are ready. Discount calculation failed. Contact an administrator.
discountStates.OutOfSync: Sales are ready. Discount totals do not match daily statistics; breakdown is withheld.
discountStates.Superseded: The source statistics changed. Refresh this product.
